anatomy.en: The first genu, 2.0 mm, where the nerve turns posteriorly onto the tympanic segment. It lies 2–4 mm from the medial end.
anatomy.ko: 제1슬이다. 2.0 mm. 신경이 뒤로 꺾여 고실부가 된다. 안쪽 끝에서 2–4 mm에 있다.

function.en: The greater petrosal nerve leaves the ganglion here.

sources.citation: Cummings Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery, 7th ed., Ch. 126 Anatomy of the Temporal Bone, External Ear, and Middle Ear
